verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes an official MCP server at mcp.sentry.dev. It connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs and managing projects, with optional org/project scoping and an experimental flag. The docs and pricing page both reference setting up and accessing MCP, including on the free plan. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in real use, and detailed authentication/setup documentation in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
Use Sentry without leaving your agent conversations by setting up the Sentry MCP server and Sentry CLI.
You can optionally scope the connection to an organization or project
Sentry MCP: fix production issues right from your LLM
